narrativeReportMd:
# uri R4-to-R6 breaking-change assessment

## Bottom line
No local material breaking changes were found for the `uri` primitive datatype. The canonical artifact remains present in R6 with the same id, kind, type, cardinalities, primitive value representation, FHIRPath string type, and `\S*` regex.

## Scope
The analysis compared the R4 and R6 core package StructureDefinitions for `uri`, their package index entries, package metadata, the batch manifest row, and the R6 `PrimitiveType` base definition only enough to classify the base hierarchy shift as out of scope.

## Main migration themes
R4 `uri` instances remain locally compatible with R6 `uri` validation rules. Implementers should still review the cross-version primitive base hierarchy if their code generator or runtime model assumes primitive datatypes inherit directly from `Element`.

## Highest-impact findings
There are no local high-impact findings. The R6 `baseDefinition` change to `PrimitiveType` is a potentially important runtime/codegen concern, but it belongs to the base/infrastructure artifact analysis under the inherited-scope rule.

## Findings requiring human review
No local `uri` finding requires human review. Confidence would improve slightly with official diff notes or narrative spec pages confirming that no prose-only URI semantic rule changed.

## Backward-compatible design observations
The local `uri.value` definition was preserved rather than narrowed, renamed, or retyped, so no backward-compatible alternative is needed for a local breaking change.

## Follow-up analysis
Review `PrimitiveType`/`DataType` for the R6 primitive hierarchy change and any generated-model consequences across all primitive datatypes.

summary.executiveSummaryMd: No local material breaking changes were found for `uri`. The only material-looking difference is the R6 move of primitive datatypes under `PrimitiveType`, which is a scoped-out base hierarchy issue. The main uncertainty is absence of official diff/narrative pages confirming there is no prose-only URI semantic change.
summary.migrationThemesMd: No data transform is needed for the local `uri` value shape: `uri.value` remains optional `0..1`, serialized as an XML attribute for XML, typed as FHIRPath `System.String` with FHIR type `uri`, and constrained by the same `\S*` regex. Migration programs should not add artifact-specific logic for `uri`; instead, code generators and validators should handle the cross-cutting R6 `PrimitiveType` base artifact consistently.
summary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high because the R4 and R6 StructureDefinitions and package index entries are present locally, the canonical identity matches exactly, and the local differential elements are structurally identical. Confidence is not absolute because official diff notes and narrative spec pages were not available to confirm the intent behind metadata and hierarchy changes.

checkedNoMaterialChange.notesMd: The canonical URL, id, name, kind `primitive-type`, type `uri`, status `active`, normative metadata, derivation, and `abstract=false` flag are preserved. Version, package, publisher, date, jurisdiction, and generated text metadata changed as expected for R6. The baseDefinition change is explicitly out of scope as a primitive base hierarchy issue.

The local differential contains the same two element ids in both versions: `uri` and `uri.value`. The snapshot still exposes inherited `uri.id` and `uri.extension`, but those inherited elements are not local findings.
`uri` remains `0..*` and `uri.value` remains `0..1`. Inherited `uri.id` and `uri.extension` cardinalities also match, but inherited member changes are scoped out.
`uri.value` remains `http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.String` with the `structuredefinition-fhir-type` extension value `uri`. No choice type was added or removed.
`uri` is a primitive string-like datatype and has no Reference-typed element or target profile list in either version.
No terminology binding is present on `uri` or `uri.value` in either StructureDefinition, so there is no binding strength or ValueSet delta to assess.

No local differential constraint was added, removed, or changed. The inherited snapshot `ele-1` FHIRPath expression remains `hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())`; only inherited human text differs at the root, and that is sourced to `Element`.
Neither version defines a fixed value, pattern, or default value for `uri` or `uri.value`.
No maxLength, minValue, or maxValue is present in either version. The primitive regex extension on `uri.value` remains `\S*`.
`isModifier` remains false for the snapshot elements examined; no modifier reason or modifier semantics were introduced locally.
`isSummary` remains false for `uri`, `uri.id`, `uri.extension`, and `uri.value` in the snapshots.
No local slicing is defined in the `uri` differential in either version.

The local root short, definition, and URI comment are unchanged. The `uri.value` differential short and definition are unchanged. Inherited extension wording differences are treated as inherited/base-artifact text.
`uri.value` remains represented as `xmlAttr`; no JSON/XML primitive representation change was found locally.

A local R6 `uri` value has the same value/extension shape and primitive regex as R4. R6-only StructureDefinition metadata such as `type-characteristics` is not instance content and does not create a data round-trip problem for `uri` values.

nonBreakingNotableChanges.title: R6 adds explicit type-characteristics metadata for uri
nonBreakingNotableChanges.whyNotBreakingMd: R6 adds StructureDefinition extensions marking `uri` as `can-bind` and `has-length`, plus work-group/jurisdiction/generated-text metadata. These are artifact metadata additions, not changes to the instance element shape, cardinality, primitive regex, or serialization representation.
nonBreakingNotableChanges.migrationAwarenessMd: Tooling that reads StructureDefinition metadata may now see explicit primitive capabilities for `uri`. Code generators should consume these as descriptive metadata and should not create a new instance field or reject R4-shaped `uri` values because of them.

followUpDependencies.reasonMd: R6 changes `uri.baseDefinition` from `Element` to `PrimitiveType`. The effect on generated class hierarchies, validators, and shared primitive behavior should be assessed once for `PrimitiveType`/`DataType`, not duplicated as a local `uri` finding.
